t1_xff_rotation.attack: Attacker rotates X-Forwarded-For on every request to evade per-IP tracking.

t2_xff_framing.attack: Attacker spoofs a victim's IP in X-Forwarded-For and hits the honeypot, getting the victim blocked.

t3_captcha_bypass.attack: Attacker supplies a static CAPTCHA token to skip Tier 2.

t4_admin_unblock.detail: unauthenticated unblock HTTP 200; attacker next login HTTP 401
t4_admin_unblock.attack: Hard-blocked attacker calls the admin unblock endpoint without credentials.

t5_audit_wipe.attack: Unauthenticated caller deletes the audit log via factory reset.

t6_simulation_endpoint.attack: Simulation endpoint lets any caller choose its own source IP.

t7_admin_read.attack: Unauthenticated read of live logs and blocked-IP lists (information disclosure).
